ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely low macro-level ratio; the surface is dominated by low-intensity (dark) pixels with high-intensity (white/tan) pixels restricted to sparse speckling and distal tip clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous low-intensity dark field across both lobes; high-contrast tan and brown geometric clusters at distal tips; stochastic distribution of micro-scale white spots across the central and lateral fluke regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central notch with a measured interior angle of approximately 45-50 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations along the trailing edge; significant topographic protrusion and irregularity at the distal tips caused by biological encrustation.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex sweep trajectory extending from the axial peduncle to the distal lobe tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of tan/brown circular anomalies at both distal tips (barnacle colonization); isolated high-contrast white micro-spots scattered across the dark ventral surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle clusters on distal lobe edges; distinct yellow-green circular anomaly located at the inferior medial junction of the fluke and peduncle.
other_distinctive_markers: A singular, high-contrast yellow-greenish circular pixel cluster at the ventral base of the fluke.
